records.title: Multiplying whole numbers and fractions
records.inspected: Official HTML introduction and five teaching points; target repeated-addition point1 distinguished from broader mixed-number/scaling/inverse points. No full teacher guide/video claim.
records.adopted: Repeated equal fractional quantities can be expressed as whole-number multiplication; allow totals aboveone.
records.rejected: Do not import general fraction×fraction, division, mixed-number arithmetic or reverse-quantity algorithms as required. Source3.9 was inspected as a contrast and rejected as the primary match.

demoInventory.say: Kolmesta piirakasta otetaan kustakin kaksi viidesosaa. Katso, kun palat siirtyvät vatiin yksi kerrallaan. Kolme kertaa kaksi palaa on kuusi palaa, ja jokainen on yhä viidesosa: kuusi viidesosaa. Viisi palaa täyttää yhden kokonaisen.
Neljä vierasta saa kukin kolme neljäsosaa. Kaksitoista neljäsosaa täyttää kolme vatia: kolme kokonaista piirakkaa. Nimittäjää ei kerrota, koska palan koko pysyy samana.

planning.concreteToRepresentation: Equal paper-unit strips, eachgroup same a/b → repeat groups →move identical fractional pieces →whole bins at bpieces →k×a/b=(ka)/b. Keep improperfraction valid rather than force mixed-number conversion.
planning.interaction: Step whole-groups forward/back, play/stop/reset/end exact-size fractional-piece collection. Separate direct numerator/denominator answer accepts equivalent amounts with no mandatory model taps.
planning.help: Count groups and parts pergroup, then state eachpartunit1/b. kwholemultiplier can be writtenk/1but not required.
